detail: Every deckent do dies at EXACT_RECOVERY_TERMINAL_SETTLEMENT_HOLD:747-001:hold:production-wiring-missing-worker-evidence. Seven surfaces attempted (recover --force, resume real run, recover --resume, recover --restore-tasks source-read, cleanup, runs --close-stale, fresh deckent do). Mechanism + three owner options: durum-raporu.md EK-4 s3.
The worker result-contract directive is in the prompt and in dist, but no worker .result carrying productionWiringEvidence has ever been observed.

npx tsc --noEmit exits 2 with one error in src/cli/repl/native-transport.ts(604,38) TS2339. npm run build:all chains tsc, so no rebuild can succeed until group C fixes it. Not in the transferred scope; the same command exited 0 at 08:27Z with all transferred changes present.

isDecidedExactSettlementHold admits only 1 of the 11 production-wiring settlement codes. Measured NOT sufficient for 747 alone: its archive terminal seal reads null. Evidence: durum-raporu.md EK-4 s4. Deliberately not implemented.
INVOCATION_RECEIPT_PRE_DISPATCH_WRITE_FAILED at 182s did not reproduce on the identical goal. Root cause unknown. BUG-H names the store failure code if it recurs; it does not fix it.
recover --dry-run counts only files to be archived, not files to be preserved nor the sprint-state removal, so it reads as 'nothing to do'.

scripts/authority-handoff.mjs hardcoded filesChanged/verification/findings to [] although operating policy s8 declares them, and could only hash a raw identity value so a transferor could not record a counterpart-reported digest. Both fixed additively (defaults unchanged). Owner-approved tooling: review before commit.

provider-authority-keyring.ts:711 pseudonymizeAccount is an HMAC over a host-local pseudonym root, so a counterpart on another host can neither reproduce nor verify it. It cannot serve a cross-party handoff receipt. Both sides therefore self-attest with sha256(canonicalJson({provider,authMode,stableAccountIdentity})).
